ja: 今は絶対に、再デプロイ禁止だ。
en: Under no circumstances should we redeploy now.
alternatives: On no account should we redeploy now.
We must not redeploy under any circumstances.
point: 否定の副詞句を文頭に出すと should we の倒置

ja: リリース、私が止めてればなあ。
en: I wish I'd stopped that release.
alternatives: If only I'd stopped that release.
I wish I'd held off on that release.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + 過去完了

ja: 止まったら私に知らせて。
en: Tell me if it stops.
alternatives: Let me know if it stops.
Alert me if it stops.
point: これからの条件でも if 節は現在形。

ja: 原因を、まだ追ってます。
en: We're still tracking down the cause.
alternatives: We're still hunting down the cause.
We're still trying to track down the cause.
point: track down は「突き止める」。目的語は cause

ja: 警報が鳴ってれば、気づけたのに。
en: Had the alert fired, we'd have known.
alternatives: If the alert had fired, we'd have known.
If the alert had gone off, we'd have known.
point: 過去の反実仮想は if + 過去完了、主節は would have

ja: 証明書が期限切れだと判明した。
en: It turned out the certificate had expired.
alternatives: We found out the certificate had expired.
We discovered that the certificate had expired.
point: turn out の後ろは that 節。先の出来事は過去完了

ja: 何が動かない？
en: What's not working?
alternatives: What isn't running?
What's out of action?
point: what で動かないものを尋ねる。

ja: 午前三時から、ずっと火消しです。
en: We've been firefighting since 3 a.m.
alternatives: We've been putting out fires since 3 a.m.
We've been working on the outage since 3 a.m.
point: since + 起点で続く動作は have been -ing

ja: 我々が退けた可能性は今は要注意だ。
en: The possibility we dismissed now demands attention.
alternatives: We can't ignore the possibility we dismissed anymore.
The possibility we rejected now demands our attention.
point: we dismissed は我々の過去の判断、now は現在の要注意状態。

ja: 何が起きたか、まだ不明です。
en: We still don't know what happened.
alternatives: We don't yet know what happened.
We're still unclear on what happened.
point: know の後の what 節は平叙文の語順

ja: ロールバックを試して。
en: Try a rollback.
alternatives: Try rolling back.
Try rolling it back.
Please try a rollback.
point: 命令文は動詞から始める

ja: 再起動して。
en: Restart it.
alternatives: Please restart it.
Reboot it.
point: 命令文は動詞で始める

ja: 私たちは確認を終えた。
en: We finished checking.
alternatives: We're done checking.
We completed our checks.
point: finish の後は checking の形。

ja: この障害の引き金は分かる？
en: Any idea what triggered this outage?
alternatives: Do you know what triggered this outage?
Any idea what caused this outage?
point: Any idea what で原因に心当たりがあるか尋ねる。

ja: チームに状況を伝えて。
en: Update the team.
alternatives: Let the team know.
Tell the team the status.
point: update は人を目的語にできる

ja: 障害は公開前に始まってた。
en: The outage had started before release.
alternatives: It had started before release.
The outage began before we released.
point: 「前から」の過去は had + 過去分詞

ja: 設定変更が引き金だったかも。
en: The config change may have triggered it.
alternatives: It might have been the config change that triggered it.
Perhaps the config change triggered it.
point: may have + 過去分詞で過去の可能性を柔らかく言う

ja: 警報が壊れたら誰も気づかない。
en: If alerts failed, nobody would know.
alternatives: If the alerts broke, nobody would notice.
If alerts stopped working, nobody would know.
point: 仮定は if + 過去形、would + 原形

ja: 私が見てもいい？
en: May I see it?
alternatives: Can I look at it?
Could I check it?
point: May I で見る許可を求める。

ja: 私はもう原因を特定した。
en: I've already isolated the cause.
alternatives: I've already identified the cause.
I've already tracked down the cause.
point: isolate the cause は原因を他の要因から切り分ける。

ja: 私たちは運用担当に止めさせた。
en: We had ops pull the plug.
alternatives: We got ops to shut it down.
We had operations stop it.
point: pull the plug は稼働中のものを停止させること。

ja: 我々が早く気づけば今は後手でないのに。
en: Had we noticed sooner, we wouldn't be playing catch-up.
alternatives: If we'd noticed sooner, we wouldn't be behind now.
We wouldn't be playing catch-up had we noticed sooner.
point: 過去の発見と今の後手の状態を混合仮定法で結ぶ。

ja: 前より影響が小さいよ。
en: The impact is smaller now.
alternatives: The impact is lower than before.
The impact is less than before.
point: 比較は形容詞 + er

ja: 収まって見えても障害は未解決だ。
en: Contained though it seems, this outage remains unresolved.
alternatives: Although apparently contained, this outage still isn't resolved.
This outage remains unresolved despite seeming contained.
point: contained は影響を抑えた状態で、解決済みとは限らない。

ja: 三時にアラートが鳴った。
en: The alert fired at three.
alternatives: An alert went off at three.
The alarm went off at three.
point: アラートが鳴るは fire / go off

ja: 落ちた原因は、設定変更でした。
en: What took us down was a config change.
alternatives: It was a config change that took us down.
A config change is what took us down.
point: 「原因は～」を強調するなら What ～ was の形

ja: 再発を恐れ我々は偽りの安心を疑った。
en: Fearing recurrence, we questioned what passed for reassurance.
alternatives: Fearing another occurrence, we challenged the supposedly reassuring statements.
We challenged what passed for reassurance, fearing another recurrence.
point: pass for は本物でないのにそのものと見なされる含み。

ja: 30分後にまた報告します。
en: I'll update you in 30 minutes.
alternatives: I'll post another update in 30 minutes.
I'll give you an update in 30 minutes.
point: 「〜後に」は in。after ではない

ja: 影響は東京ユーザーのみだった。
en: Only users in Tokyo were affected.
alternatives: Only Tokyo users were affected.
Only users in Tokyo were impacted.
point: users in ~ と前置詞句で後ろから修飾

ja: 落ちたのは中枢だと私たちは見ている。
en: We suspect what crashed was the linchpin.
alternatives: We think the core component crashed.
We suspect the central component failed.
point: linchpin は全体を支える要の部分を指す。

ja: 我々のかつての油断が今災いになった。
en: The complacency we displayed has come home to roost.
alternatives: The complacency we showed has now brought unpleasant consequences.
Our earlier complacency has now brought bad consequences.
point: come home to roost は過去の行いの悪い結果が戻る。

ja: 先にロールバックすべき。
en: We should roll back first.
alternatives: I think we should roll back first.
We'd better roll back first.
point: 名詞は rollback、動詞は roll back と分ける

ja: 原因を特定できなかった。
en: We couldn't pinpoint the cause.
alternatives: We weren't able to pinpoint the cause.
We couldn't identify the cause.
point: pinpoint は原因を特定する定番語

ja: 対象のユーザーには連絡済み。
en: Affected users have been notified.
alternatives: Affected users have already been notified.
We've notified the affected users.
point: 連絡済みは現在完了の受動 have been notified

ja: 問題はいつ始まった？
en: When did it start?
alternatives: When did the problem begin?
When did this problem start?
point: when と過去形で発生時刻を尋ねる。

ja: 私が閾値を早く見直してればなあ。
en: I wish I'd revisited the thresholds sooner.
alternatives: If only I'd reviewed the thresholds earlier.
I wish I had reviewed the thresholds sooner.
point: wish + 過去完了。thresholds は複数形

ja: 私は彼に確認を頼んだ。
en: I asked him to check.
alternatives: I asked him to check it.
I asked him to verify it.
point: ask 人 to do で行動を頼む。

ja: 警告に従えば我々は余波を防げたのに。
en: Had we heeded warnings, we'd have averted the fallout.
alternatives: If we'd heeded warnings, we'd have prevented the fallout.
We'd have avoided the fallout had we heeded warnings.
point: heed は警告を重く受け止めて従う。

ja: エラー数が急増している。
en: There's a spike in errors.
alternatives: There's been a spike in errors.
Errors are spiking.
point: 急増は a spike in ~

ja: サポートは直ったと言った。
en: Support said it was fixed.
alternatives: Support told us it was fixed.
Support said it had been fixed.
point: said の後は時制を一つ過去側へ ずらす

ja: 私は安全宣言には慎重でいたい。
en: I'd be wary of declaring the coast clear.
alternatives: I'd hesitate to announce we're in the clear.
I'd be cautious about saying the danger has passed.
point: the coast is clear は危険が去ったという宣言。

ja: 後で初めて我々は警告の重みを知った。
en: Only in hindsight did we appreciate the warning.
alternatives: We understood the warning's significance only in hindsight.
Only afterward did we grasp the warning's importance.
point: only の句を先頭に出すと did が主語の前に来る。

ja: 我々は客に伝えなきゃ。
en: We must tell customers.
alternatives: We have to tell customers.
We need to tell customers.
point: must で顧客への連絡が必要と伝える。

ja: 原因を調べてるよ。
en: I'm checking the cause.
alternatives: I'm investigating the cause.
I'm looking into the cause.
point: 「調べる」は check。進行形で「今調べ中」

ja: 担当は見かけの復旧を一時しのぎと言った。
en: Ops said the apparent recovery was a reprieve.
alternatives: Ops said the seeming recovery was just temporary relief.
Ops said it only looked recovered for the moment.
point: reprieve は問題が消えたのでなく一時的に逃れた状態。

ja: 客が困ってるよ。
en: Customers are having trouble.
alternatives: Customers are having problems.
Customers are struggling.
A customer is having trouble.
point: 複数名詞は冠詞なしで are

ja: 原因は設定ミスだったよ。
en: It was a config error.
alternatives: The cause was a bad config.
A config mistake caused it.
point: 過去の be は was

ja: 私たちは被害を抑えなきゃ。
en: We need to contain the damage.
alternatives: We have to limit the damage.
We must contain the damage.
point: contain は被害が広がるのを抑える。

ja: パッチしてれば、今は落ちてない。
en: If we'd patched, we'd be up now.
alternatives: If we'd applied the patch, we'd be up now.
We wouldn't be down now if we'd patched it.
point: 過去の原因 + 今の結果は had done と would be

ja: これが効いた修正です。
en: It's the fix that worked.
alternatives: It's the fix which worked.
Here's the fix that worked.
point: 物を説明する関係代名詞は that

ja: 昼からずっと止まってる。
en: It's been down since noon.
alternatives: It has been down since noon.
It's been offline since noon.
point: since + 時点には現在完了

ja: 今回のほうが深刻です。
en: This one is worse.
alternatives: This outage is worse.
This is worse than last time.
point: bad の比較級は worse

ja: 問題がある。
en: There's a problem.
alternatives: Something is wrong.
We've got a problem.
point: there is で問題の存在を伝える。

ja: 私が指揮するなら油断は許さないのに。
en: Were I in charge, I'd tolerate no complacency.
alternatives: If I led, I wouldn't tolerate any complacency.
I'd allow no complacency if I were in charge.
point: tolerate no complacency は油断を一切容認しないことを表す。

ja: 我々の失敗は判断力を手順で代用した点だ。
en: What failed us was substituting procedure for judgment.
alternatives: It was substituting procedure for judgment that failed us.
We failed by substituting procedure for judgment.
point: substitute A for B はBの代わりにAを使う。what の節で失敗の原因を強調する。

ja: 修正後もサーバーは延命状態だ。
en: Though patched, the server's on borrowed time.
alternatives: Even patched, the server's days are numbered.
Even patched, the server won't last long.
point: on borrowed time はいつ終わってもおかしくない状態。

ja: 変更を戻したので、様子見です。
en: Having rolled back the change, we're monitoring.
alternatives: With the change rolled back, we're monitoring.
Since we rolled back the change, we're monitoring.
point: Having + 過去分詞で「もう〜したので」を短く言う

ja: 一時しのぎで我々を油断させないで。
en: Don't let a stopgap lull us into complacency.
alternatives: Don't let a stopgap fix give us false confidence.
Don't allow a temporary fix to make us complacent.
point: lull 人 into complacency は安心させて警戒心を失わせる。

ja: 再起動していいですか？
en: Can I restart it?
alternatives: May I restart it?
Is it okay to restart it?
point: 許可を求めるなら Can I / May I

ja: 私は直せるよ。
en: I can fix it.
alternatives: I can repair it.
I'm able to fix it.
point: can の後は動詞の原形。
